name: Archimedes
biography: Applied Eudoxus's method of exhaustion to calculate areas (squaring the parabola exactly) and to bound the value of pi; also the chief surviving witness, via a letter to King Gelon, to Aristarchus's heliocentric hypothesis; killed when Rome captured Syracuse in 212 BC.
